name: Sharon Gannon
reason: No website of her own and no usable photo: two web searches found only her teacher page on jivamuktiyoga.com, the Jivamukti Yoga brand she co-founded but handed to new owners (Jivamukti Global) in 2017, whose only contact is the company inbox; that site's photos sit under /wp-content/, which its robots.txt disallows, and her publisher Monkfish returned 504 to us (nothing more fetched from it). No YouTube channel of her own was found.
